title: The Abacus Herders of Tally Day
description: On Tally Day, the market’s red abacus beads roll loose. The bookkeepers have until sundown to catch every last one.
alt: Two bookkeepers with a willow branch and a woven basket try to catch giant red abacus beads rolling down snowy market steps.
pairing: An imagined year-end counting holiday × a herd of runaway abacus beads
